old_string:
        slots = _planned_slots(input)
        # Only pad when the input's own structure says the set is larger than
        # the model produced; never pad on a guess.
        if slots > len(units) and seeds:
            for companion in self._expand(seeds):
                if len(units) >= slots:
                    break
                if companion in units:
                    continue
                units.append(_snap(companion, self.lexicon))

new_string:
        slots = _planned_slots(input)
        # Only pad when the input's own structure says the set is larger than
        # the model produced; never pad on a guess. Preferred fill order:
        # labels retrieved from matched prior cases first (they are evidence),
        # then graph companions (they are inference).
        if slots > len(units) and seeds:
            pool = list(seeds) + self._expand(seeds)
            for candidate in pool:
                if len(units) >= slots:
                    break
                snapped = _snap(candidate, self.lexicon)
                if snapped and snapped not in units:
                    units.append(snapped)
